  • Classes in org.openehealth.ipf.commons.map used by org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.support.map
    Class
    Description
    Mapping
    A named translation from one code system into another, as Mappings serves it and a MappingLoader produces it.
    MappingFunctionRegistry
    Named functions that an Unmatched.Computed fallback can refer to.
    MappingLoader
    Turns a mapping source document into Mappings: a SimpleMapping for every table the source declares, and, where the format spreads one translation over several tables, a CompositeMapping over them, listed after its parts.
    MappingWriter
    Writes Mapping records as a mapping source document, the counterpart of MappingLoader.

  • Classes in org.openehealth.ipf.commons.map used by org.openehealth.ipf.commons.map
    Class
    Description
    CompositeMapping
    A mapping that holds no entries of its own but the names of other mappings - its parts - and answers through them.
    CompositeMapping.Builder
    Mutable helper for MappingLoader implementations, which assemble a composite while walking their source document.
    DefaultMappings
    In-memory Mappings implementation, backed by one forward and one reverse index per mapping.
    Entry
    A single key/value-pair of a Mapping, qualified by the Equivalence that holds between the two, and optionally by the human-readable name of either side.
    Equivalence
    Degree of correspondence between the key and the value of a mapping Entry.
    Mapping
    A named translation from one code system into another, as Mappings serves it and a MappingLoader produces it.
    MappingConverter.Conversion
    The outcome of reading one source document.
    MappingFunctionRegistry
    Named functions that an Unmatched.Computed fallback can refer to.
    MappingFunctions
    Read access to the functions that Unmatched.Computed fallbacks name.
    MappingLoader
    Turns a mapping source document into Mappings: a SimpleMapping for every table the source declares, and, where the format spreads one translation over several tables, a CompositeMapping over them, listed after its parts.
    Mappings
    Typed front door to a set of Mappings, whatever format they were loaded from.
    Mappings.Builder
    Assembles a Mappings instance from mapping sources and named functions.
    MappingService
    Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
    as of 6.0, use Mappings, which is String-typed, returns Optional rather than null, and has neither of the two string conventions this interface's implementations carry.
    MappingWriter
    Writes Mapping records as a mapping source document, the counterpart of MappingLoader.
    SimpleMapping
    A translation table: entries of its own, the identifiers of the two code systems involved, and the fallback behavior for either direction.
    SimpleMapping.Builder
    Mutable helper for MappingLoader implementations, which assemble a mapping incrementally while walking their source document.
    Translation
    The answer to a lookup together with what a caller needs to build a coded value from it: the code system it belongs to and its display, if the mapping declares one.
    Unmatched
    What a Mapping answers with when the requested key has no entry.
